item.title: What I write
item.description:
A few articles to start with:

  • Faster to Build, Harder to Get Right: AI speeds up building software, not deciding what is worth building.
  • AI as a Junior Employee: capable, useful and in need of supervision.
  • A.I. = Accelerate Inefficiencies: why AI amplifies the problems an organisation already has.
  • Blending AI and Product Management: how the AI product phases fit into the traditional product lifecycle.
  • From Project to Product, from Product to Platform: three operating models that run in parallel, not in sequence.

All articles →

item.title: What I build
item.description:
I still build things. These are the projects I would start with:

  • Property Visual Finder: a fine-tuned vision model that ranks property listings by what is in the photos.
  • AI Cloud Migrator: recommends the right Cloud migration strategy for each application, fast.
  • Product Work Focus Tool: AI-assisted feature prioritisation that keeps the Product Manager in control.
  • News Titles Shift: an experiment that rewrites news headlines for a reader’s profile, then shows exactly how it did it.
